label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — User-controlled 'host' parameter flows through separate DNS resolution (line 38: resolveHost(host)) and then to outbound fetch (line 43: fetchHttpByHostname(host)). Although there's a non-public address check, the SSRF pattern of separating DNS resolution from network access remains exploitable. Attacker can provide hostnames that pass the check but resolve to internal resources via DNS manipulation or record poisoning. Resolved sink value at line 43 is the user-controlled 'host' parameter passed to fetchHttpByHostname(), which constructs URLs with http:// + host + /api.

evidence.note: SSRF pattern: DNS resolution via resolveHost(host) followed by fetchHttpByHostname(host)
fetchHttpByHostname constructs URL with user-controlled host parameter
